_readme: An entry clears exactly ONE deploy from the exit code. It never hides it: an acknowledged
deploy is still printed in full on every fire, tagged with the issue that settled it, and
`pnpm check:deploy-origin -- --no-acks` prints the raw truth with every ack ignored.
Matching is by EXACT `deployId`. There is deliberately no way to ack a CLASS: an entry that
said 'manual is fine' would re-create the unenforced convention this detector replaced.
An entry needs `deployId`, `issue`, `reviewedAt` and `why`. An entry missing any of those
does NOT apply -- the deploy alarms as an ordinary bypass and the run prints a WARNING
naming the incomplete entry. Fail closed.
⛔ THESE ACKS ARE WEAKER THAN `scripts/boot-arm-repair-acks.json`'s, AND DELIBERATELY SO.
That ledger demands a `fixCommit` that made recurrence impossible. There is no such commit
here and there cannot be one: the hole is a permissions hole on Render's dashboard, and the
workspace's only member is its own ADMIN (measured 2026-09-23: GET /v1/owners/tea-d7macfog4nts73ai6p40/members
returns exactly one row, eetiennecg@gmail.com, role ADMIN). An ack here means 'seen, reviewed,
dispositioned on a ticket' and nothing more. Do not import the stronger ledger's semantics.
Acking is not the remedy. Each entry should name the issue where the deploy was actually
adjudicated, so the ledger reads as a list of decisions rather than a list of dismissals.

acks.why: Adjudicated: it was an ENV-VAR write, not a settings write. Render's markers are disjoint and this row carries envUpdated:true with NO updatedProperty -- and there is not one updatedProperty row in the entire 2000-event corpus (2026-07-10..09-23), so VERB 2 is ruled out by Render's own labelling, not by inference from the label alone. The trigger object is byte-identical to dep-d9h1j5nlk1mc738s57qg (2026-07-23), the row ENV_WRITE_TRUTH itself cites as the canonical env-write occurrence. NOT an agent: no heartbeat run existed anywhere in the company at the instant (nearest ended 09-20T22:21:00Z, next began 09-21T10:15:27Z, n=0 in flight), and 0 of 3 recent single-key API env writes (09-19 x2, 09-20 x1) produced any deploy -- so TRA-3724's measurement holds for the API verb and the write came through another surface (dashboard, or the banned full-set PUT). WHICH surface and WHICH key are UNREAD and unreadable: GET /env-vars returns {key,value} only, with no timestamp or actor. Cost: none -- but NOT because Render pinned. 9472ced3 was the branch TIP from 09-20T21:57:16Z to 09-22T19:33:37Z (45h36m, nothing pushed to main), so tip-semantics and serving-semantics were the same SHA and this row cannot discriminate them. Had anything landed on main in those 4h11m it would have shipped unguarded. Acked because it is adjudicated, not because it is safe: no gate is available for the surface that produced it (same one-ADMIN-member hole measured on TRA-4789), so this detector remains the only control. ENV_WRITE_TRUTH and CLAUDE.md corrected in the same commit -- the falsified part was the UNQUALIFIED wording 'an env-var write does not auto-deploy', which was surface-blind.

The dashboard deploy found in the TRA-4384 freeze-sprint report §2 and the reason TRA-4789 exists. It ran none of render-redeploy.mjs's gates. Adjudicated by the CEO: it landed inside the then-active cadence ceiling and cost nothing -- luck, not a control. Acked so that the NEXT press of the button is the thing this detector reports, rather than being buried under a permanent day-one red.

Second of THREE dashboard deploys on 2026-09-13, all carrying b22a9999. TRA-4384 §2 reported one; the full history read for TRA-4789 found three (04:04Z, 04:51Z, 12:49Z). Same commit, same actor, same adjudication as the first -- all three land outside the 13:25-20:00Z RTH freeze and carry a commit that was already the deploy target.

Third of the three. 12:49Z is 36 minutes before the RTH freeze opens at 13:25Z -- the closest any of them came to a gate that would have refused, and the clearest statement of why an unenforced convention was not enough.

Adjudicated: an ENV-VAR write through a non-API surface (dashboard or the banned full-set PUT) -- envUpdated:true, no user, no updatedProperty; still zero updatedProperty rows in the corpus, so VERB 2 stays ruled out by Render's own labelling. NOT the API verb (TRA-3724 holds: 0/3 single-key writes deploy) and NOT attributable to an agent: exactly ONE heartbeat run was in flight company-wide at 16:41:06Z (CTO run 2eed1080, 16:37:45->16:46:21Z, the TRA-2111 fold ratification), a read-and-disposition run whose comment landed at 16:41:03Z -- 3 seconds before deploy_started -- with health-route reads only and no Render write in its trail; and even a single-key API write from it would not have materialised a deploy. WHICH key: unreadable (GET /env-vars has no timestamp/actor). UNLIKE the 09-21 row this one DISCRIMINATES tip vs serving, and it PINNED SERVING: it carried 7f290414 (serving since the gated 10:50:27Z api deploy dep-dapqtsrbc2fs73bo467g) while origin/main's tip was 2e6feeaa, >=11 commits ahead (e08e2d05 pushed 16:10Z, 2e6feeaa 16:34Z). That is the OPPOSITE direction from the 07-23 occurrence, which shipped the TIP over the operator's 13:23Z pin -- the surface's commit choice is now measured in BOTH directions (tip-ship n=1 Jul, serving-pin n=1 Sep, indeterminate n=1) and must be treated as UNPREDICTABLE; the treat-as-capable-of-shipping-the-tip posture stands. Both Sept rows built in 50-65s vs ~3min for api deploys, consistent with a same-image env-apply -- recorded as hypothesis, not a read. COST WAS REAL, unlike 09-21: first bypass row to land INSIDE the 13:25-20:00Z RTH freeze; it killed serving pid 76 at 5.80h uptime mid-RTH and the replacement crash-looped three times inside RTH (server_failed nonZeroExit:1 at 16:48:11 / 16:51:26 / 16:59:16Z -- the TRA-4158 boot-burst heap trips, spender #12 on that tape). Acked because adjudicated, not safe: no gate exists for this surface (the RTH freeze included), so this detector remains the only control. ENV_WRITE_TRUTH and CLAUDE.md updated with the discriminating measurement in the same commit.

⛔ THE FIRST `trigger: manual` DASHBOARD DEPLOY TO LAND INSIDE A WINDOW A GATE WAS ACTIVELY HOLDING SHUT -- and the SECOND gate-free deploy to do so overall. `freezeState(2026-10-06T14:31:10.791Z)` returns `{frozen:true, isWeekday:true, min:871}`: Tuesday, 61 minutes into RTH. Gate 4 WOULD have refused it; the dashboard button ran that gate, and every other gate, not at all. ⛔ DO NOT read this as the first ever -- dep-daq028id0e5s73aka5i0 (2026-09-23T16:41:06Z, `service_updated`) is 13 days EARLIER, is also inside the freeze (`min:1001`), and was adjudicated on TRA-4845 on 2026-09-24 with a REAL measured cost (it killed serving pid 76 at 5.80h uptime mid-RTH and the replacement crash-looped three times inside RTH). TRA-5267's own filing called this row the first because it read a 421-commit-stale local copy of THIS LEDGER, in which TRA-4845's entry does not exist -- the local-is-a-fork trap, on the ack ledger itself. What is new here is the SURFACE (the dashboard button, not the env surface) and the MARGIN, below. GATE-BY-GATE, measured rather than assumed: gate -1 `ops/deploy-hold.json` held `holds: []` at the tip of that instant (c3a2d337), so it would have passed; no EMBARGOES row covers 2026-10-06 (gate 5 pass); the only COMMIT_HOLDS row is 204f2984 until 2026-07-27 (gate 6 pass); the only CADENCE_CEILINGS row ran 2026-09-08T18:50Z..2026-09-19T04:00Z (gate 10 pass); the box booted and served, so the live AUTH_SECRET was non-blank and usable (gate 7 pass -- auth.ts:34 throws under NODE_ENV=production on a blank value). EXACTLY ONE gate would have refused, and it is the freeze. WHAT SHIPPED: c3f1cead -> c3a2d337, FORWARD +6, `merge-base --is-ancestor` YES both from the then-serving commit and to origin/main -- not a rollback -- and it carried the then-branch-TIP (the next commit, ee2db4c1, landed 10:36:02 ET, five minutes after the press). A `Deploy latest commit` press, not a pin. All three 2026-10-06 presses carried the then-tip; that is the discriminating fact about `trigger: manual` on this host, and it is the opposite of the env surface's behaviour, which TRA-4845 measured as UNPREDICTABLE in both directions. CONTENT: the 6-commit diff touches only packages/server/src/{env-intent,observability/env-drift,observability/health-routes,directional-exploration-allowance}.ts plus their tests, docs/observability.md and render.yaml. The exploration-allowance change adds `hostGateFlag`/`hostGateArmed`/`reachable`/`unreachableReason` to a SUMMARY object and a note string; no decision path moved. Observe-only. The render.yaml deltas are DECLARATIONS (OPTIONS_IDEAS_MONTHLY_USD_CAP 50 then back to 5; an ENABLE_OPTION_LIVE_DIRECTIONAL arming-provenance rewrite) and they did NOT reach the live env store on this deploy: Render labels a blueprint sync with its own `trigger: blueprint_sync`, and there are ZERO such rows in the 30-day window (n=130: 122 api, 6 manual, 2 service_updated, unknown=0). ⛔ THE MARGIN IS THE FINDING, AND IT IS NOT TO A GATE. TRA-4789's ack called 36 minutes the closest any of them came to a gate that would have refused. This press was 98 SECONDS after a REAL-MONEY OPTION FILL. From `/api/health/order-provenance-capture` (durable: `ephemeral:false, dataDir:set`) the ENTIRE 2026-10-06 order census is two rows, and they BRACKET this deploy: v0nni `buy_to_open` NU261113C00015500 qty 1 FILLED at 14:29:32.720Z on real account ***9652 -- 98s BEFORE the deploy was created at 14:31:10.791Z -- and admin `buy_to_open` SOFI261113C00016000 qty 1 FILLED at 14:35:11.474Z on real account ***0154 -- 31s AFTER the deploy finished at 14:34:40.688Z and the replacement process came up. Both of the day's real-money fills sit within +/-100s of a press that ran no gate. These are the two live opens the TRA-5242 40-open watch is now clocking. NOTHING WAS LOST, and that is MEASURED, not inferred from the absence of a complaint: both rows carry `execQuantity: 1` with `witness: submit_ledger`; `/api/health/options-live` reads `liveUnmanagedRisk {total:0, unexplained:0, uncoveredBrokerContracts:0}`, so no broker contract is uncovered by the journal and no position was orphaned across the boot; the 2026-10-06 brokerOutcome rows read `verdict: green` for both armed books with 0 in every reject class, 0 preSubmitAborts, 0 transport faults and 0 close faults -- and those are DURABLE, not this process's since-boot tally (`brokerOutcomesFromSnapshot=true`, TRA-3937), which matters because the box has rebooted five times since; `pnpm check:broker-census` grades the session CLEAN. ⛔ WHAT IS NOT MEASURABLE AND MUST NOT BE CALLED ZERO. (1) The warm quote cache: `probeCached` is a since-boot field and this restart plus four more (2026-10-07 00:34/00:46/00:51/01:19Z) zeroed it. The cache state at 14:34:40Z is GONE -- UNMEASURED. A restart destroys the instrument that would price the restart. (2) Whether an engine cycle was in flight at 14:34:40Z and was silently dropped: same sinceBoot problem, UNMEASURED BY CONSTRUCTION. (3) The go-live soak clock -- TRA-1996's NAMED harm and the stated reason for the autoDeploy=no pin -- is UNINSTRUMENTED: a case-insensitive grep for soakClock/soakDays/soakSince/goLiveSoak across packages/server/src, scripts/ and docs/ returns exactly one hit, in packages/server/src/promotion-service.test.ts, unrelated. 'It reset the soak clock' can be neither measured nor refuted anywhere on this box. That is a hole in the instrument set, not a zero. (4) The 2026-10-06 2879 regime row was ALREADY graded BLIND on TRA-5246 for its own reasons; this deploy does not extend that and is not asserted to have caused it. ACKED because it is adjudicated and every loss term that IS readable reads zero -- NOT because it is safe, and NOT because the behaviour has been stopped. The permission fix is still unavailable: re-measured 2026-10-07, GET /v1/owners/tea-d7macfog4nts73ai6p40/members returns exactly ONE row, eetiennecg@gmail.com, role ADMIN, status active. Detect-only stands; see TRA-5267.

Second of THREE dashboard presses on 2026-10-06 (01:23Z, 12:45Z, 14:31Z) -- the same three-in-a-day shape as 2026-09-13, thirteen days after TRA-4789 closed as detect-only. That recurrence is the evidence that detection alone has not changed the behaviour, and it is why TRA-5267 answers the close-or-detect question in writing instead of leaving it open a fourth time. `freezeState(2026-10-06T12:45:47.243Z)` returns `{frozen:false, min:765}` -- 39 minutes before the freeze opens at 13:25Z. No gate would have refused it: gate -1 holds empty at tip 19287586, no embargo covers 10-06, the only commit hold expired 2026-07-27, the only cadence ceiling closed 2026-09-19T04:00Z, and the box booted and served (gate 7 pass). FORWARD +1 from the then-serving 5b4fe737, `is-ancestor` YES, and 19287586 was the branch tip at that instant (the next commit, c3f1cead, landed 12:49:21Z, 3m34s later) -- a `Deploy latest commit` press. Nothing real-money was in flight: the durable 2026-10-06 order census holds exactly two rows, both at 14:29Z/14:35Z, so this deploy straddled no submission. Cost: zero on every readable term; the quote-cache, in-flight-cycle and soak-clock terms are UNMEASURED/UNINSTRUMENTED for the reasons recorded on the 14:31Z row, and that is stated rather than rounded down to zero. Acked as adjudicated, not as sanctioned: a press that happens to land 39 minutes before the freeze took the same ungated path as one that lands inside it.

Cost: zero on every readable term, with the same UNMEASURED/UNINSTRUMENTED terms named on the 14:31Z row. Acked as adjudicated.
